kymrisch.et: Borrowed from Welsh Cymr- as in Cymro (“Welsh person”), Cymry (“Welsh people”), Cymru (“Wales”), Cymraeg (“Welsh [of the language]”), Cymreig (“Welsh [of the culture]”) with the adjective suffix -isch.

Kyanit.et: From Ancient Greek κύανος (kúanos, “blue”) + -it (used to form names of minerals).

s: a rural district of Thuringia; seat: Sondershausen
